how_to_run: Give the skill the brand book, the draft and the channel for each case. A case passes when every must_flag item is flagged, nothing in must_not_flag is flagged, and the verdict matches. Log each run in results.md.

cases.draft:
6.30am. First batch of kaya toast is out.

Kopi and two toast, $4.20 till 10am.

Who's here before us? ☕
must_not_flag: $4.20 (a price the brand gives up front is allowed)

cases.draft: Unlock your morning with our mouth-watering kaya toast. A true hidden gem! What's your order?
must_flag: hidden gem -> say where we are
must_not_flag: the closing question (matches How we close)

cases.draft: We're unlocking new opening hours from Monday, elevating your weekday breakfast. See you from 6.30am.
New pandan kaya!!! 🔥🔥🥥☕😍 Only a few left!!! Grab yours now!!!
must_flag: Urgency rule: 'Only a few left!!!' is pressure that isn't true unless a real limit is given
Personality: shouty, outside Warm and Down-to-earth

cases.draft: We are pleased to inform you that Kopi Corner will be closed on Monday for maintenance purposes. We apologise for any inconvenience caused.
must_flag: Contractions rule: 'We are pleased to inform you' is the listed Don't
How we close: no clear call to action (for example when we reopen)

cases.draft: Voted Singapore's best kopi by 10,000 customers. "Changed my mornings forever", says Mei. Come see why.
must_flag: 'Voted Singapore's best kopi by 10,000 customers': ranking and number with no source
the quote from Mei: testimonial with no source or permission given
best (close to the banned 'best in town')
must_not_do: invent a replacement statistic or quote

cases.draft: We're hiring a morning barista. 6am starts, kopi on the house. Message us if you know someone.
must_flag: note that LinkedIn has no block in Channel by channel, so only Personality and How we write everywhere were checked
says there is no brand book and points to toolkits/02-brand-voice/worksheet.md
must_not_do: make up a voice for the brand
